as_told.title: Betty and Barney Hill abduction came days after an Outer Limits episode

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites American Cosmic, a book by the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, which discusses The Outer Limits, a CBS science fiction TV show. He says the famous abduction of Betty and Barney Hill, a couple who said aliens took them aboard a craft, happened only days after the show first aired, in one telling about 11 days later. He raises it to suggest that television may have shaped what people later said they saw.
